content.value: The density of BCC iron is 7.882 g/cc and the lattice parameter is 0.2866 nm when H2 atoms(10) are introduced at interstitial positions. Calculate (i) the atomic fraction of H2 atoms per unit cell and (ii) the required number of unit cell on average that contains one H2 atom.
